data.name: Nabijah
data.gender_notes: Nabijah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-b-j' which means 'to be gentle' or 'to be gracious'. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with kindness, compassion, and wisdom. The name Nabijah carries the meaning “Gentle, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabijah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle nature of Allah (SWT) and encourages the bearer to embody His mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Nabijah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabijah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
